backup_action.create_backup.title: Create a backup?
backup_action.create_backup.body:
Your health (§c%s§r) is below the backup threshold you set (%s).
Do you want to create a backup (and overwrite the previous one)?
This message will not reappear for %s seconds.
backup_action.roll_back.title: Roll back to the last backup?
backup_action.roll_back.body:
You just suffered lethal damage (§c%s§r).
Do you want to roll back to the previous backup?
config.title: DeathRollback Configs
config.backup_threshold.description: The health value that the player must drop below to trigger a backup reminder.
config.backup_message_interval.descripti: The minimum time interval before the next backup reminder appears after closing the current one.
